description: Header file declaring RBus API functions related to WAN connectivity check in a Cisco/Universal C implementation, including initialization, registration, unregistration, interface commit, URL commit, and URL delete functions.

methods.name: CosaWanCnctvtyChk_RbusInit
methods.description: Initializes RBus communication for WAN connectivity check.

methods.name: CosaWanCnctvtyChk_Reg_elements
methods.description: Registers WAN connectivity check elements of a specific type with RBus.

methods.name: CosaWanCnctvtyChk_UnReg_elements
methods.description: Unregisters WAN connectivity check elements of a specific type from RBus.

methods.name: CosaWanCnctvtyChk_Intf_Commit
methods.description: Commits interface information related to WAN connectivity check.

methods.name: CosaWanCnctvtyChk_URL_Commit
methods.description: Commits a URL for WAN connectivity check for a specific instance.

methods.name: CosaWanCnctvtyChk_URL_delDBEntry
methods.description: Deletes a URL entry from the database for a specific WAN connectivity instance.
